scripts._comment_postinstall: Applies patches/@tinacms+cli+2.5.6.patch, which makes `tinacms build` compile the 11 MB admin SPA only when TINA_PUBLISH_ADMIN=true. Stock, it compiles unconditionally — 60s of every build, on a bundle scripts/prune-admin.mjs then deletes, because a deployed static site has no data layer to serve it. That is 60s CI never needed and 60s Cloudflare never needed. `tinacms dev` is untouched (it serves the admin from Vite, not this bundle), so local editing is unaffected. REMOVE when the CLI grows a flag for this — tinacms/tinacms has no equivalent as of 2.5.6; re-generate with `npx patch-package @tinacms/cli` if you bump the version.
scripts.dev:container: container run --name plcc-dev --detach --rm --env ASTRO_CONTAINER_DEV=1 --publish 4321:4321 --mount type=bind,source="$PWD",target=/workspace --tmpfs /workspace/node_modules --workdir /workspace docker.io/library/node:lts sh -lc "npm ci && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4321"
scripts._comment_clean:vite: Vite's SSR dep cache goes stale across Astro/adapter upgrades and surfaces as 'The file does not exist at node_modules/.vite/deps_ssr/...'. Anything that loads the Astro config through Vite hits it, so both `build` and `check` clear it first rather than each carrying its own copy of the rm.
scripts._comment_clean: Every derived directory in one place, for when a build goes strange. All four are gitignored and regenerate on the next build.
scripts._comment_prebuild: Clears the stale dep cache, then generates public/_redirects from the short-links collection so astro build copies it into the deploy.
scripts._comment_build: Keep this named `build`: Cloudflare's build command lives in a dashboard the repo can't assert, and when it said `npm run build` and that was a bare `astro build`, the deploy failed on the unresolvable generated client. There is no valid plain `astro build` here — getStaticPaths queries the CMS. scripts/build.mjs explains the flag choice, the heap size and NODE_ENV, each of which has broken a deploy.
scripts.postbuild: node scripts/prune-dist.mjs && node scripts/prune-admin.mjs && node scripts/check-tina-lock.mjs
scripts._comment_tina:lock: Rewrites tina/tina-lock.json — the compiled schema TinaCloud indexes — from the files codegen emits. Needed after any tina/config.ts change, because tinacms build never writes it and only tinacms dev does. postbuild fails the build when it drifts; see scripts/check-tina-lock.mjs.
scripts._comment_compare: Regression check for the Tina migration: renders both builds down to what a reader sees and diffs them. Needs a built baseline in the sibling worktree — see spike/compare-builds.mjs. `compare:serve` puts the two builds on adjacent ports for a side-by-side look.
